record OaAllocator {
    calls: usize;
    fail_at: usize;
    live: usize;
    rejected: bool;
    host_failed: bool;
    phase: u32;
    rejected_phase: u32;
}

fn oa_text(stream:u32, text:*u8)->bool {
    var size:usize = 0usize;
    while text[size] != 0u8 { size = size + 1usize; }
    return rmd0_host_write_stream(stream, text, size) == 0i32;
}

fn oa_number(stream:u32, value:usize)->bool {
    var digits:[u8;20] = uninit;
    var begin:usize = 20usize;
    while true {
        begin = begin - 1usize;
        digits[begin] = ((value % 10usize) as u8) + 48u8;
        value = value / 10usize;
        if value == 0usize { break; }
    }
    return rmd0_host_write_stream(stream, &digits[begin], 20usize - begin) == 0i32;
}

fn oa_allocate(user:*u8, size:usize)->*u8 {
    var state:*OaAllocator = user as *OaAllocator;
    (*state).calls = (*state).calls + 1usize;
    if (*state).calls >= (*state).fail_at {
        if !(*state).rejected { (*state).rejected_phase = (*state).phase; }
        (*state).rejected = true;
        return null(*u8);
    }
    var result:*u8 = rmd0_host_alloc(size, 16usize);
    if result == null(*u8) { (*state).host_failed = true; }
    else { (*state).live = (*state).live + 1usize; }
    return result;
}

fn oa_release(user:*u8, allocation:*u8)->unit {
    var state:*OaAllocator = user as *OaAllocator;
    if allocation == null(*u8) || (*state).live == 0usize { trap; }
    (*state).live = (*state).live - 1usize;
    rmd0_host_free(allocation);
}

fn oa_report(fail_at:usize, message:*u8, context:*RmdContext)->unit {
    oa_text(2u32, "allocation attempt ");
    oa_number(2u32, fail_at);
    oa_text(2u32, ": ");
    oa_text(2u32, message);
    if (*context).error_count != 0usize {
        oa_text(2u32, ": ");
        oa_text(2u32, &(*context).error[0usize]);
    }
    oa_text(2u32, "\n");
}

fn oa_check(sources:*RmdSource, count:usize, composed:bool)->i32 {
    var fail_at:usize = 1usize;
    var failed_read:usize = 0usize;
    var failed_overload:usize = 0usize;
    var failed_final:usize = 0usize;
    while true {
        var state:OaAllocator = make OaAllocator {
            calls:0usize, fail_at:fail_at, live:0usize, rejected:false, host_failed:false,
            phase:0u32, rejected_phase:0u32
        };
        var allocator:RmdAllocator = make RmdAllocator {
            user:&state as *u8, allocate:oa_allocate, release:oa_release
        };
        var context:RmdContext = uninit;
        rmd_context_init(&context, &allocator);
        var resources:RsStage = uninit;
        rs_init(&resources, &context);
        var stage:OvStage = uninit;
        var hooks:OvHooks = uninit;
        if composed { ov_resources_init(&stage, &resources, "resources_x64_v1", &hooks); }
        else { ov_init(&stage, &context, "rmd0_x64_v1", null(*OvHooks)); }
        var success:bool = true;
        var index:usize = 0usize;
        while index < count && success {
            if composed {
                success = ov_resources_read(&stage, &sources[index], 0usize, sources[index].size);
            } else { success = ov_read(&stage, &sources[index], 0usize, sources[index].size); }
            index = index + 1usize;
        }
        if success {
            state.phase = 1u32;
            if composed { success = ov_resources_prepare(&stage); }
            else { success = ov_prepare(&stage); }
        }
        var stage_complete:bool = success;
        if success {
            state.phase = 2u32;
            if composed { success = rs_prepare(&resources); }
            else { success = rmd_collect(&context) && rmd_resolve(&context) && rmd_check(&context); }
        }
        var valid:bool = !state.host_failed && context.failure == null(*u8);
        if success {
            valid = valid && !state.rejected && !stage.failed && !resources.failed && context.error_count == 0usize;
        } else {
            valid = valid && state.rejected && context.error_count != 0usize && context.error[0usize] != 0u8;
            if !stage_complete { valid = valid && stage.failed; }
            if composed { valid = valid && resources.failed; }
        }
        if !valid { oa_report(fail_at, "invalid failure state or invalid test input", &context); }
        rmd_context_destroy(&context);
        if state.live != 0usize || context.arena.blocks != null(*u8) || context.arena.bytes_reserved != 0usize {
            oa_report(fail_at, "context destruction retained allocations", &context);
            valid = false;
        }
        if !valid { return 1i32; }
        if success {
            if !oa_text(1u32, "overload allocation: ") || !oa_number(1u32, fail_at - 1usize) ||
               !oa_text(1u32, " failure points checked (read ") || !oa_number(1u32, failed_read) ||
               !oa_text(1u32, ", overload ") || !oa_number(1u32, failed_overload) ||
               !oa_text(1u32, ", final ") || !oa_number(1u32, failed_final) ||
               !oa_text(1u32, ")\n") { return 1i32; }
            return 0i32;
        }
        if state.rejected_phase == 0u32 { failed_read = failed_read + 1usize; }
        else {
            if state.rejected_phase == 1u32 { failed_overload = failed_overload + 1usize; }
            else { failed_final = failed_final + 1usize; }
        }
        fail_at = fail_at + 1usize;
    }
    trap;
}

fn main(argc:i32, argv:**u8)->i32 {
    if argc < 3i32 {
        oa_text(2u32, "usage: overload-alloc plain|resources SOURCE...\n");
        return 2i32;
    }
    var composed:bool = c_equal(argv[1usize], "resources");
    if !composed && !c_equal(argv[1usize], "plain") {
        oa_text(2u32, "expected plain or resources mode\n");
        return 2i32;
    }
    var count:usize = (argc - 2i32) as usize;
    var sources:*RmdSource = rmd0_host_alloc(count * sizeof(RmdSource), alignof(RmdSource)) as *RmdSource;
    if sources == null(*RmdSource) {
        oa_text(2u32, "cannot allocate test source descriptors\n");
        return 1i32;
    }
    var index:usize = 0usize;
    while index < count {
        sources[index] = make RmdSource {
            path:argv[index + 2usize], bytes:null(*u8), size:0usize, identity:index as u64 + 1u64
        };
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    var result:i32 = 0i32;
    index = 0usize;
    while index < count {
        if rmd0_host_read_file(sources[index].path, &sources[index].bytes, &sources[index].size) != 0i32 {
            oa_text(2u32, "cannot read test source: ");
            oa_text(2u32, sources[index].path);
            oa_text(2u32, "\n");
            result = 1i32;
            break;
        }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    if result == 0i32 { result = oa_check(sources, count, composed); }
    index = 0usize;
    while index < count {
        rmd0_host_free(sources[index].bytes);
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    rmd0_host_free(sources as *u8);
    return result;
}
